class_policy.stable: The registered shape and semantics are frozen; any field addition, removal, type change, or reinterpretation requires a new schema identifier.
class_policy.extensible: Strict v0 evidence may gain a successor, but the registered shape is not weakened in place and external stability is not promised.
class_policy.experimental: In-tree and deterministic, but not a compatibility promise until explicitly promoted.
